text:
zara: heads up 80	
We got a report from LUCID_ANALYTICS showing lower token counts on their April usage vs their internal counters. looks like a tokenizer mismatch for model fragmel-1b after the tokenizer-service vocab refresh on 2026-04-02.

mike: can you paste the reconc query / numbers?

zara: sanitized snapshot:
```sql
-- compare token counts computed by customer vs our metering tokenizer for 2026-04-03..2026-04-04 UTC
select 'customer_tokens' as src, sum(tokens) from customer_token_reports where acct='LUCID_ANALYTICS' and model='fragmel-1b' and ts between '2026-04-03' and '2026-04-04'; -- 12,450,000
select 'metered_tokens' as src, sum(tokens) from tokens_metered where acct='LUCID_ANALYTICS' and model='fragmel-1b' and ts between '2026-04-03' and '2026-04-04'; -- 11,840,000
-- delta = 610,000 tokens (missing on our side)
```

prod_ash: product confirm: tokenizer-service rolled a vocab patch (v2026-04-02) that removed some legacy byte-pair merges used by fragmel-1b. our metering tokenizer uses the new service, but many clients running older local tokenizers report counts using the previous merges, hence the mismatch.

mike: are the raw request payloads intact? did any requests get dropped or re-tokenized differently server-side?

zara: raw payloads present. this is purely a tokenization idempotency drift: same payload yields different token counts depending on tokenizer version. no replays or duplicates.

prod_ash: impact scope: three customers show >100k token deltas; LUCID_ANALYTICS is largest at 610k tokens. other two are under 50k tokens.

mike: pricing: our token SKU for fragmel-1b is $0.00005 per token. missing = 610,000 -> $30.50. For the other two combined delta = 74,000 -> $3.70. total remediation = $34.20.

billing.bot: Suggested actions: 1) create supplemental invoice S-2026-0403-LUCID-30.50 for the missed tokens, 2) create smaller supplemental invoices or credits for the two other accounts, 3) include invoice memo: "Supplemental charge for tokenization mismatch due to tokenizer-service vocab update (see internal ticket PROD-2080)." Requires finance + legal approval.

legal_uk: contract check: our terms allow retroactive billing for legitimate metering corrections with 30d notice. must provide itemized token CSV and a clear explanation. recommend offering a short troubleshooting window to let customer dispute payloads.

cfo_emma: two asks before approve: 1) confirm dedupe that these tokens weren't later counted in a subsequent window (avoid double-bill), 2) ensure customers get an itemized CSV and a 7-day dispute window.

zara: ran cross-window join: overlap with later windows < 200 rows. safe to proceed. uploaded audit CSVs: s3://redwood-recon/2151001234/lucid_token_delta.csv (internal).

prod_ash: mitigation plan: rollback tokenizer-vocab patch to v2026-04-01 for the metering service and schedule a graceful migration with versioned tokenization APIs. ticket PROD-2080 created and assigned. also we'll publish a note to SDKs to surface tokenizer versions in client reports.

mike: outcome options: 1) issue supplemental invoice for $30.50 to LUCID and similar small invoices for others, or 2) absorb as courtesy for anything < $50. what's recommended?

cfo_emma: given amounts small but material, issue supplemental invoice to LUCID for $30.50 and automatically bill the two smaller accounts (combined $3.70) as supplemental invoices too. offer a one-time waiver of late fees and a 7-day dispute window. require invoice memo: "Supplemental charge for tokenization mismatch due to internal tokenizer vocab update on 2026-04-02." also CC legal and product.

billing.bot: Creating supplemental invoice drafts: S-2026-0403-LUCID-30.50, S-2026-0403-OTHER1-2.30, S-2026-0403-OTHER2-1.40. Reference thread 2151001234. Status: DRAFT.

zara: uploaded CSV for LUCID: s3://redwood-recon/2151001234/lucid_token_delta.csv and started wiring the invoice note.

legal_uk: approved wording. add dispute process link and contact info on the invoice.

cfo_emma: finalize invoices and queue notification. product to prioritize PROD-2080 and include a postmortem on the deploy checklist.

billing.bot: Supplemental invoices finalized and posted. Notifications queued to customers. Draft refs: S-2026-0403-LUCID-30.50 (posted).

prod_ash: tokenizer vrollback applied to metering service; PROD-2080 assigned to me and infra for versioned rollout. will publish SDK guidance this week.

mike: thanks. please add an internal billing note and close once customers either accept or dispute.

zara: closing loop in ledger and adding follow-up infra + product tickets: INFRA-8961, PROD-2080. thanks team.
